summary: The pioneer of Kanban board collaboration — simple, but one of the most widely replicated web interfaces in history.
moat: Trello's moat is radical simplicity and Atlassian bundling: millions of non-technical teams, schools, and families use Trello boards because there is virtually zero learning curve for drag-and-drop cards. Power-Up integrations connect boards to Google Drive, Slack, and Salesforce. The vulnerability is extreme commoditization: a full-featured Kanban board can now be vibe-coded in a single afternoon using modern AI development tools.

challengers.name: Linear, Notion boards, and AI Kanban generators
challengers.evidence: Notion's native database boards and Linear's engineering workflows have captured modern teams, while open-source Kanban clones like Wekan and Planka provide identical utility for free.
